title: The selection a person shared from the viewer
description: Stored in .o3j-view/selection.json by open3dj view; agents read it with inspect fields=[selection]. Element addresses hold for rev only: when stale is true the head moved on, and face numbers may name other faces (follow ref, when present, instead).

rev.description: The revision the person was looking at.

ts.description: When the selection was shared (server clock, ISO 8601).

head.description: inspect only: the project's head revision now.

stale.description: inspect only: true when rev is not the head, so face numbers may have moved.

note.description: inspect only: what the selection means for the next call.

address.description: What to pass as a target: the occurrence path, or <path>@elem:face:<n> for a face. Edges have none yet.

element.description: A face: its element address in the definition, face:<n>.

faces.description: An edge: the faces it bounds, as face:<n>.

ref.description: A named reference of the definition that resolves to this face (<definition>.<name>), from the revision's reference resolver.

fingerprint.description: The kernel's fingerprint of ref (measured, in the definition's naming frame).

observed.description: Numbers read off the display mesh in the browser, in the definition's frame (mm). Observed, not measured: within the export chord of the true surface.
